_note: V4.7b's break-up verb. The split is pro-rata among the sector's EXISTING body firms -- no new firm ids are minted, because a register entry with no authored content cannot price a payroll (the reads fall back to the loader's firm object, and a minted id has none). The children are body-tier by construction: the body never escalates, so a broken champion can never re-form -- the structural pin, not a promise. The major's own headcount reads zero through the failed flag, and its jobs move with the share the body firms absorb.

actions.name: Break Up the Firm
actions.summary: Competition law dissolves the champion. Its market share passes to the smaller firms of the sector; its payroll goes with it; it does not come back.
